outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Nulliparous women younger than 35 years of age delivering vertex-presenting singletons at term
finding: Adolescents were significantly less likely to undergo cesarean delivery overall and in labor compared to older nulliparous women, even after adjusting for multiple maternal, neonatal, and labor characteristics.
mod_finding: Adolescents were half as likely to undergo cesarean delivery overall and 40% less likely to undergo a primary cesarean delivery in labor compared to adults.
